assertions.description: Navigator exposes the globalPrivacyControl property (the GlobalPrivacyControl mixin is included).
navigator.globalPrivacyControl is a boolean (the spec IDL is `readonly attribute boolean globalPrivacyControl`).
The property is readonly: assigning to it does not change the value scripts read back.
globalPrivacyControl is defined as a getter with no setter on the Navigator prototype chain.

The Sec-GPC header a fresh same-origin request carries agrees with the DOM property: header present with value "1" iff the property reads true (barring a mid-session preference change, which the spec pins to gpcAtNavigation until reload). Header absent plus property false also passes — the UA MUST NOT generate the field when the preference is off.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(!('globalPrivacyControl' in navigator))return false;const res=await fetch('/v157/global-privacy-control-in-chrome/echo-gpc',{cache:'no-store'});if(!res.ok)throw new Error('echo route '+res.status);const data=await res.json();const headerOn=data.received&&data.value==='1';if(data.received&&data.value!=='1')return false;return headerOn===navigator.globalPrivacyControl;})()

assertions.description: When the Sec-GPC field is sent at all, its value is exactly "1" (the ABNF allows no other field value, and the field is never generated to say "0").
assertions.test: (async()=>{const res=await fetch('/v157/global-privacy-control-in-chrome/echo-gpc',{cache:'no-store'});if(!res.ok)throw new Error('echo route '+res.status);const data=await res.json();return data.received===false||data.value==='1';})()
